name: units
body: Always give distances in kilometres.

name: tone
body: I prefer short answers without small talk.

name: language
body: Reply in German unless I write in another language.

name: format
body: Use plain text, no markdown tables.

name: name
body: Call me Sam, not Samuel.

name: dates
body: Write dates as day month year, for example 5 March 2025.

name: honesty
body: Say so when you are not sure instead of guessing.

name: spelling
body: Use British spelling.

name: sources
body: Always say where a fact came from.

name: steps
body: Explain steps in order, one at a time.

name: currency
body: Show money in euros.

name: brevity
body: Keep every answer under 150 words unless I ask for more.

name: timezone
body: My timezone is Central European Time.

name: jargon
body: Avoid jargon and explain terms the first time you use them.

name: code-style
body: I use tabs, not spaces, in every project.

name: dog
body: My dog Bruno is allergic to chicken.

name: garden
body: My tomatoes are in the south bed and need watering every second day.

name: car
body: My car is a 2016 Golf diesel and the service is due every 15000 km.

name: project-x
body: Project X uses PostgreSQL and the deploy runs from the main branch.

name: recipe
body: For my carbonara I use guanciale, pecorino and no cream.

name: running
body: My marathon plan peaks at 60 km per week in week 12.

name: cabin
body: The cabin wifi password is Lakeside2024 and the firewood is in the shed.

name: boss
body: My manager Priya likes weekly summaries on Friday afternoon.

name: mortgage
body: The mortgage rate is fixed at 3.9 percent until 2031.

name: guitar
body: I am learning Blackbird by the Beatles, fingerstyle, in drop D.

name: flight
body: The flight to Lisbon leaves on 3 June at 07:15 from terminal 2.

name: allergy
body: When I cook for my sister, leave out nuts.

name: book
body: I am reading Middlemarch and want chapter summaries without spoilers.

name: server
body: The home server runs Debian and backs up to the NAS at 2 am.

name: kids
body: Lena has swimming on Tuesdays and piano on Thursdays.

name: note1
body: Remember this.

name: note2
body: It is better that way.

name: note3
body: Maybe later.

name: note4
body: I like the other one more.

name: note5
body: Do what we said before.

name: note6
body: Same as last time.

name: note7
body: Check it.

name: note8
body: That was fine.

name: note9
body: Not that one.

name: note10
body: Use the usual.
